decision: found the repo had never been installed and yarn was missing
why: wanted a real green baseline before planning anything
evidence: node v26.5.0, no node_modules, npm global install blocked by sandbox
result: installed via npx yarn 1.22.22, 43s, tree still clean

decision: captured the pre-change baseline for typecheck and tests
why: the plan needs a known-good number to measure regressions against
result: typecheck green 5.2s; 116 test files, 1677 tests green, 22.3s

decision: confirmed the dev server renders the real app, not just a 200
why: a port answering is a proxy; I wanted the actual canvas
result: app renders on :3001, splash says drawings live only in browser storage

decision: read .env.development and found five backends the app already assumes
why: changes the framing from add a backend to bring the assumed backends in-repo
result: json store, library backend, ws room server, AI backend, firebase all external

decision: wrote scripts/verify.sh with gates for deps, typecheck, lint, format, test and boot
why: one rerunnable command a reviewer can run instead of trusting my word
result: all six gates pass on clean master

decision: broke typecheck on purpose to confirm the gate goes red
why: a gate nobody has seen fail is not a gate
result: red with exit 1, green with exit 0 after revert

decision: found my own boot gate was lying and fixed it
why: it passed in 0.06s by probing a server leaked from the previous run
result: now kills the process group, reclaims the port, and fails if it leaks

decision: confirmed there is no server code anywhere in the tree
why: wanted to be sure before claiming the repo is client-only
evidence: grep for express/fastify/createServer hit only unrelated matches; no api or server dir
result: zero server code; firebase-project holds only firestore and storage rules

decision: recorded the full six-gate baseline on clean master
why: this is the number every later phase gets measured against
result: deps, typecheck 5s, lint 11s, format 3s, test 19s, boot all PASS in 43s total

decision: will bring the five already-assumed backends in-repo rather than invent a new one
why: the client already calls them; building something else beside them would duplicate the path
result: open, pending user confirmation of priority

decision: routing the shared-contract mechanism and the authz model to the architect skill
why: both are one-way doors and I should not pick them by taste alone
result: open

decision: the server will relay and snapshot but never author element changes
why: clients already reconcile on version and versionNonce; a second writer would break that assumption
result: open, constraint recorded

decision: SUPERSEDES the five-service plan; scope cut to a server package, shared domain types, and drawings plus users
why: user pushed back that breadth was not the point; auth and E2EE are not what this repository needs to exercise
evidence: user direction plus reviewer verdict section C
result: 3 phases instead of 8

decision: elements stay opaque JSON on the server; client runs restoreElements on load
why: there is no machine schema to derive from; restore.ts does imperative normalization
evidence: packages/excalidraw/data/restore.ts, no zod or ajv anywhere in the repo
result: shared types now cover only the new domain, much smaller

decision: hardened deps gate to yarn install --frozen-lockfile --check-files
why: a present node_modules can be stale or built from a different lockfile
result: passes in 3s, now actually compares tree to lockfile

decision: free_port now refuses to kill a process that is not our dev server
why: it used to SIGKILL whatever held the port, which could be the user's own process
result: scoped kill plus an EXIT trap so cancellation cannot leak vite

decision: boot gate now follows the entry module instead of only checking the page title
why: a broken index.tsx still serves title-bearing HTML, so the old gate passed a broken build
result: verified: broken entry gives 500 and FAIL, revert gives PASS

decision: removed set -m job control from the boot gate
why: the background process group made esbuild stop mid-transform and killed the dev server
evidence: crash was TypeError in esbuild main.js under Node v26.5.0
result: boot green and idempotent across three consecutive runs

decision: found the husky pre-commit hook is commented out and there is no .nvmrc
why: both are cheap realism gaps and the commit gate is currently inactive
evidence: .husky/pre-commit, no .nvmrc, engines >=18 vs CI 20 vs Docker 24
result: open, proposed for phase 0

decision: wrote PLAN.md with the descoped three-phase plan and a Phase 0 checklist
why: the plan only existed in chat messages, which is the wrong place for something to come back to
result: written, prettier clean, all gates green

decision: service goes at top-level server/, shared types go in packages/api-types
why: excalidraw-app already sets the precedent that apps are top level and libraries live in packages
result: decided

decision: confirmed release.js publishes an explicit allowlist rather than globbing packages/*
why: wanted to be sure a new package under packages/ cannot publish by accident
result: safe; plan still marks both new packages private
